cases.description: Tier 1 Stationary Combustion: Natural Gas (100,000 scf)
Tier 1 Stationary Combustion: Diesel Fuel (1,000 gal)
Tier 2 Stationary Combustion: Fuel Gas with site GC carbon content (50,000 m3)
Tier 2 Stationary Combustion: Fuel Oil with measured HHV & Carbon content (50 tonnes)
Tier 3 Stationary Combustion: Direct CEMS Stack Gas Monitoring
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Measured stack gas dry standard volume: 1,000,000 Nm3.
Measured continuous CO2 concentration: 8.50% vol.
CO2 volume = 1,000,000 * 0.0850 = 85,000 Nm3.
Molar volume at standard conditions (0 C, 1 atm): 22.414 m3/kmol.
CO2 mass = (85,000 / 22.414) * 44.01 kg/kmol / 1000 = 166.885 t CO2.
Measured stack CH4 concentration: 15 ppmv = 0.000015 -> CH4 volume = 15 Nm3.
CH4 mass = (15 / 22.414) * 16.042 / 1000 = 0.01073 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 166.885 + 0.01073 * 28 = 167.185 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 3 Stationary Combustion: Calibrated Coriolis Fuel Mass Meter + Online GC
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Metered fuel mass: 200,000 kg.
Online GC real-time carbon fraction: 75.25%.
Carbon mass = 150,500 kg C.
Complete combustion via incinerator / thermal oxidizer efficiency 99.9%.
CO2 = 150,500 * 0.999 * (44.01 / 12.011) / 1000 = 551.108 t CO2.
Unoxidized CH4 = 150,500 * 0.001 * (16.042 / 12.011) / 1000 = 0.201 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 551.108 + 0.201 * 28 = 556.736 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 1 Flaring: Default flare factor on flare volume (100,000 m3)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Volume: 100,000 m3 = 100 kSm3.

CO2 = 100,000 * 2.38 kg/m3 / 1000 = 238.0 t CO2.
CH4 = 100,000 * 0.0025 kg/m3 / 1000 = 0.25 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr: CH4=28): 238.0 + 0.25 * 28 = 245.0 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 1 Flaring: Standard flare volume (50,000 mscf)
Tier 2 Flaring: Field gas stream composition with 98% combustion efficiency (20,000 m3)
Tier 2 Flaring: High-efficiency assisted flare (99.2% destruction) (10,000 m3)
Tier 3 Flaring: Ultrasonic continuous flare meter + online GC (500,000 m3)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Metered flare gas: 500,000 m3 standard.
GC analysis: 88.5% CH4, 3.2% CO2, 8.3% C2+. Total kmol = 500,000 / 23.685 = 21,110.4 kmol.
Measured flame combustion efficiency via optical flare monitor = 98.4%.
Hydrocarbon C moles = 21,110.4 * (0.885*1 + 0.083*2) = 22,187.0 kmol C.
Combustion CO2 = 22,187.0 * 0.984 * 44.01 / 1000 = 960.84 t CO2.
Native CO2 = 21,110.4 * 0.032 * 44.01 / 1000 = 29.73 t CO2 -> Total CO2 = 990.57 t CO2.
Uncombusted CH4 = 21,110.4 * 0.885 * 0.016 * 16.04 / 1000 = 4.794 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 990.57 + 4.794 * 28 = 1,124.80 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 3 Flaring: Measured flare gas volume with measured flare combustion efficiency 97.5%
Tier 1 Venting: High-bleed pneumatic controllers (10 devices * 8,760 hours)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Activity: 10 devices operating 8,760 hours/yr = 87,600 device-hours.
API Compendium Table 5-15 default: 37.3 scf natural gas / device-hour.
Total gas = 87,600 * 37.3 = 3,267,480 scf = 3,267.48 mscf.
Gas composition default: 80% CH4 vol, 2% CO2 vol.
CH4 volume = 3,267,480 * 0.80 = 2,613,984 scf.
Density of CH4 at standard conditions: 0.0192 kg/scf -> CH4 mass = 2,613,984 * 0.0192 / 1000 = 50.188 t CH4.
CO2 volume = 3,267,480 * 0.02 = 65,349.6 scf.
Density of CO2 at standard conditions: 0.0526 kg/scf -> CO2 mass = 65,349.6 * 0.0526 / 1000 = 3.437 t CO2.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr: CH4=28): 3.437 + 50.188 * 28 = 1,408.70 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 1 Venting: Chemical injection pneumatic pumps (5 pumps * 4,000 hours)
cases.arithmetic_comments:

CH4 mass = 496,000 * 0.85 * 0.0192 / 1000 = 8.095 t CH4.
CO2 mass = 496,000 * 0.015 * 0.0526 / 1000 = 0.391 t CO2.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 0.391 + 8.095 * 28 = 227.05 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 2 Venting: Crude storage tank flashing calculation (10,000 bbl throughput)
cases.arithmetic_comments:

CH4 mass = 185,000 * 0.65 * 0.0192 / 1000 = 2.309 t CH4.
CO2 mass = 185,000 * 0.08 * 0.0526 / 1000 = 0.778 t CO2.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 0.778 + 2.309 * 28 = 65.43 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 2 Venting: Compressor station blowdown physical volume (5 events * 250 m3 @ 60 bar)

cases.description: Tier 1 Fugitives: Component count average factors (100 gas valves * 8,760 hours)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Activity: 100 valves in gas service * 8,760 hr = 876,000 valve-hours.
EPA/API average factor: 0.0045 kg TOC / hr / valve.
Total TOC = 876,000 * 0.0045 = 3,942 kg TOC.
Stream CH4 fraction: 75% -> CH4 = 3,942 * 0.75 / 1000 = 2.9565 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 2.9565 * 28 = 82.782 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 1 Fugitives: Light liquid pump seals (50 seals * 8,760 hours)
cases.arithmetic_comments:

Total TOC = 438,000 * 0.0199 = 8,716.2 kg TOC.
Stream CH4 fraction: 60% -> CH4 = 8,716.2 * 0.60 / 1000 = 5.2297 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 5.2297 * 28 = 146.432 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 2 Fugitives: EPA Method 21 screening ranges (20 leaking valves > 10,000 ppmv)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
20 valves with screening reading >= 10,000 ppmv.
EPA pegged emission factor for gas valves >= 10,000 ppmv: 0.0437 kg TOC / hr / valve.
Hours leaking before repair: 1,500 hours.
Total TOC = 20 * 0.0437 * 1,500 = 1,311.0 kg TOC.
CH4 content: 80% -> CH4 mass = 1,311.0 * 0.80 / 1000 = 1.0488 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 1.0488 * 28 = 29.366 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 2 Fugitives: OGI optical gas imaging survey with repair tracking
cases.arithmetic_comments:
15 leaking components identified by OGI.
EPA OGI default leak rate: 0.030 kg CH4 / hr / leak.
Duration leaking: 15 leaks * 720 hours (30 days to repair) = 10,800 leak-hours.
Total CH4 = 10,800 * 0.030 / 1000 = 0.324 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 0.324 * 28 = 9.072 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 3 Fugitives: Direct bagging measurement of compressor seals (4 seals @ 0.85 kg/hr)
cases.arithmetic_comments:

CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 13.600 * 28 = 380.80 tCO2e.

cases.description: Tier 3 Fugitives: High-flow sampler quantitative measurement across flanges
cases.arithmetic_comments:

Total operating hours: 5,000 hr -> CH4 = 0.96 * 5,000 / 1000 = 4.800 t CH4.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 4.800 * 28 = 134.40 tCO2e.

cases.description: Scope 2 Purchased Steam: Enthalpy balance & boiler efficiency (1,000 MMBtu delivered)
cases.arithmetic_comments:
Delivered steam heat: 1,000 MMBtu.
Boiler efficiency: 80% (0.80), transmission loss: 5% (0.05).
Net efficiency = 0.80 - 0.05 = 0.75 (API Compendium Exhibit 8.3 formula).
Fuel required = 1,000 / 0.75 = 1,333.333 MMBtu.
Natural gas boiler EF: 53.06 kg CO2/MMBtu.
CO2 = 1,333.333 * 53.06 / 1000 = 70.7467 t CO2.
CH4 = 1,333.333 * 0.0010 / 1000 = 0.001333 t CH4.
N2O = 1,333.333 * 0.0001 / 1000 = 0.000133 t N2O.
CO2e (AR5 100-yr): 70.7467 + 0.001333*28 + 0.000133*265 = 70.8193 tCO2e.
